title: Senior Engineering Manager - Corrosion, Coatings, or Cathodic Protection

cond_0001.intro: A successful candidate will provide technical oversight of staff, project management, and be an active participant on various projects for the Department of Defense and other government and commercial clients. Projects the Senior Engineering Manager will manage will tangibly improve military readiness by addressing and preventing corrosion on air, ground, and sea weapons systems as well as infrastructure assets.
cond_0001.responsibilities: This is a senior level management position. As such the following can be expected: Plan, coordinate, and execute engineering work on multiple significant programs. Serve as major clients' primary point of contact. Identify correct labor skills and direct/manage teams of engineers and subcontractors on projects. Serve as primary reviewer for project work, ensuring compliance with engineering standards and client's scope of work.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Candidate must be a U.S. Citizen and be willing to pursue (or have) a Government security clearance.
Relevant experience with a Bachelor's degree in Engineering. (Other technical degrees may be considered.)
Related experience managing projects and mentoring/supervising junior staff in corrosion, coatings, or cathodic protection.
Subject matter expert level technical competency in corrosion and corrosion control methods.
Prior experience working in the Department of Defense arena.
Candidates must have excellent written and/or verbal communication skills; writing samples will be requested if not submitted with the resume.
Travel will be required and varies by job assignment (expected minimum of 20%).
Preferred Requirements
Advanced education and/or Industry Certificates may substitute for up to five years of service.
Relevant experience in managing engineering, testing, field services, logistics, or other support projects for DoD customers may be considered in lieu of direct corrosion or coatings experience.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite in addition to the ability to work effectively both collaboratively and independently.
Demonstratable experience with the use of basic hand tools and familiarity with electronic and mechanical systems, and laboratory test equipment.

cond_0091.intro: A successful candidate will provide technical oversight of staff, project management, and be an active participant on various projects for the Department of Defense and other government and commercial clients. Projects the Senior Engineering Manager will manage will tangibly improve military readiness by addressing and preventing corrosion on air, ground, and sea weapons systems as well as infrastructure assets.
cond_0091.responsibilities: This is a senior level management position. As such the following can be expected: Plan, coordinate, and execute engineering work on multiple significant programs. Serve as major clients' primary point of contact. Identify correct labor skills and direct/manage teams of engineers and subcontractors on projects. Serve as primary reviewer for project work, ensuring compliance with engineering standards and client's scope of work.
cond_0091.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Candidate must be a U.S. Citizen and be willing to pursue (or have) a Government security clearance.
Relevant experience with a Bachelor's degree in Engineering. (Other technical degrees may be considered.)
Related experience managing projects and mentoring/supervising junior staff in corrosion, coatings, or cathodic protection.
Subject matter expert level technical competency in corrosion and corrosion control methods.
Prior experience working in the Department of Defense arena.
Candidates must have excellent written and/or verbal communication skills; writing samples will be requested if not submitted with the resume.
Travel will be required and varies by job assignment (expected minimum of 20%).
Preferred Requirements
Advanced education and/or Industry Certificates may substitute for up to five years of service.
Relevant experience in managing engineering, testing, field services, logistics, or other support projects for DoD customers may be considered in lieu of direct corrosion or coatings experience.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite in addition to the ability to work effectively both collaboratively and independently.
Demonstratable experience with the use of basic hand tools and familiarity with electronic and mechanical systems, and laboratory test equipment.

Projects the Senior Engineering Manager will manage will tangibly improve military readiness by addressing and preventing corrosion on air, ground, and sea weapons systems as well as infrastructure assets.
This is a senior level management position. As such the following can be expected: Plan, coordinate, and execute engineering work on multiple significant programs. Serve as major clients' primary point of contact. Identify correct labor skills and direct/manage teams of engineers and subcontractors on projects. Serve as primary reviewer for project work, ensuring compliance with engineering standards and client's scope of work.
cond_0425.requirements:
Travel will be required and varies by job assignment (expected minimum of 20%).
Candidate must be a U.S. Citizen and be willing to pursue (or have) a Government security clearance.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering required; advanced degree strongly preferred. (Other technical degrees may be considered.)
Advanced education and/or Industry Certificates may substitute for up to five years of service.
Proven track record managing projects and mentoring/supervising junior staff in corrosion, coatings, or cathodic protection.
Substantial experience managing engineering, testing, field services, logistics, or other support projects for DoD customers may be considered in lieu of direct corrosion or coatings experience.
Subject matter expert level technical competency in corrosion and corrosion control methods, with deep knowledge of corrosion control strategies and their application.
Demonstrated expertise working in the Department of Defense arena.
Candidates must have exceptional written and verbal communication skills; writing samples will be requested if not submitted with the resume.
Strong command of the Microsoft Office suite, along with the ability to work effectively both collaboratively and independently.
The candidate must have demonstrated expertise with the use of basic hand tools and solid understanding of electronic and mechanical systems, and laboratory test equipment.
cond_0425.values: We value ambition, achievement, and consistent follow-through. We believe strong outcomes come from maintaining high expectations for the work we do.

cond_0440.intro:
We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to join our team. You will take ownership of technical oversight, project management, and direct execution across projects for the Department of Defense and other government and commercial clients. The work you lead will tangibly improve military readiness by addressing and preventing corrosion on air, ground, and sea weapons systems as well as infrastructure assets.
This is a senior-level management position. You will plan, coordinate, and execute engineering work across multiple significant programs. You will serve as the primary point of contact for major clients, set direction for teams of engineers and subcontractors, and ensure all project work meets engineering standards and client scope requirements.
cond_0440.responsibilities:
Own technical oversight of staff and deliver results across multiple significant programs.
Serve as the primary point of contact for major clients.
Identify the right labor skills and direct teams of engineers and subcontractors on projects.
Lead project work review, ensuring compliance with engineering standards and client scope of work.
Drive project management and execution for DoD and other government and commercial clients.

Subject matter expert level technical competency in corrosion and corrosion control methods.
Prior experience working in the Department of Defense arena.
Excellent written and/or verbal communication skills; writing samples will be requested if not submitted with the resume.
Travel as required by job assignment (expected minimum of 20%).

Experience managing engineering, testing, field services, logistics, or other support projects for DoD customers (may be considered in lieu of direct corrosion or coatings experience).
Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite and ability to work effectively both collaboratively and independently.
